content.text:
Resubmitted with the duration repaired in operative language.

- **Change from prior version:** the duration now reads "for twelve (12) months after the end of a person's involvement in services under this Agreement" (digit-and-word form), curing the deterministic ≤12-month check while keeping the same anchor — end of involvement, not termination of the Agreement.
- **Everything else held:** mutuality ("neither party ... the other party"), scope ("directly involved in performing services under this Agreement"), and the verbatim retained "Solicit" definition supplying the general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs and the absence of any no-hire.
- **Level:** fallback, single replace, minimality gate ok:true; Article X(b) heading and numbering survive so the Article XI cross-reference still resolves.
